subject: Enclave carveout + capacity uplift — phased cutover & SOW/PO requests
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@medbridge.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal question — carveout for analytics enclave + capacity uplift

Hi Chloe,

Hope you're well — our renewal for Private deployment is up early next year and we want to fold in an isolated analytics enclave for regulated telemetry and an additional cluster for model serving. High level asks: 

- Add a dedicated analytics enclave (VPC-isolated, no shared KV caches) scoped to PHI workloads.
- Provision +2 compute clusters for steady-state serving (estimate: 40% uplift during business hours).
- Extend term from 12 to 24 months in exchange for committed reserved capacity pricing.

We attached the latest SOW (MedBridge_SOW_v3.pdf) with a rough topology. Can your team put together a phased cutover plan (zero-downtime during business hours), a MAP with milestones, and an incremental pricing sheet?

We prefer a two-phase rollout: (1) analytics enclave + compliance validation, (2) serving cluster add and traffic migration. Proposed window for the analytics cutover is mid-February.

Would love to schedule a 30-min sync this week to align next steps. Devon (cc'd) will handle the procurement side.

Thanks,
Aisha
Director, Cloud Ops — MedBridge Health
attachments: MedBridge_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Renewal question — carveout for analytics enclave + capacity uplift

Team — forwarding MedBridge's ask. Key points: isolated PHI-capable enclave + +2 serving clusters; 24-month term requested in exchange for commit.

Ask list for this thread:
- Ben: pricing for committed uplift (reserved capacity) + a proposal for a 24-month term discount schedule. Include incremental monthly delta and one-time cutover fees.
- Connor: ops/infra feasibility — footprint for an analytics enclave (network isolation, KMS/HSM requirements) and estimated lead times for provisioning new clusters in us-west region.
- Kimberly: security/compliance checklist and what artifacts we need to satisfy them (SOC 2, diagram, pen test timing).
- Markus: can you coordinate a short MAP spreadsheet and propose a two-phase timeline that minimizes customer downtime? I've started a draft we can iterate on (MB-MAP-draft.xlsx).

Aisha asked for a phased cutover mid-February for analytics. We should have a draft pricing + MAP by next Tue so we can lock a PO. Proposed sync: Thu 11/3 11:00 PT — confirm availability.

Thanks — Chloe
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick security checklist so we can scope the enclave correctly:

- Required artifacts from MedBridge: current SOC 2 report (last 12 months), network diagram for the environment touching PHI, list of third-party data processors.
- Redwood deliverables: SOC 2 boundary summary for Private deployment, KMS/HSM integration plan, encryption-in-transit diagrams, and pen-test scheduling window.

We can scope a compliance validation run ~3–4 weeks after enclave provisioning; if they want an expedited attestation we need to reserve a pen-test slot now. I've attached a short summary of our SOC-related scope (SOC2_scope_summary.pdf).

A couple of open questions for Aisha/Devon: will MedBridge require dedicated HSM keys or will a customer-managed KMS suffice? Also confirm whether analytics data will ever leave the enclave (expected: no).

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
